channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about James Johnson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about James Johnson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Norman Powell on James Johnson
item.description:
There, again, he reflected back on another former Raptors teammate.

“I’ve seen the body transformation with James Johnson, when he went from Toronto to here and how much weight he lost,”

Norman Powell on James Johnson, Oct 8, 2025. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Bennedict Mathurin on James Johnson, George Hill
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Bennedict Mathurin:

“Having James Johnson and George Hill on the team was one of the biggest blessings in my career.”

Bennedict Mathurin on James Johnson, George Hill, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on James Johnson
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle on James Johnson:

“Very important for us. Glad we could get it worked out. He's contributed so much to our organization.”

Rick Carlisle on James Johnson, Feb 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Steve Nash on James Johnson
item.description:
“I just thought we needed to change something in the second half, play with a little bit more pace.“LA obviously was making shots and spacing the floor for us. Other than that, we played with a little bit more smaller lineups, gave James Johnson and Paul [Millsap] opportunities. Just tried to make an adjustment tonight to see if we could generate some energy and pace and turn the game.”

Steve Nash on James Johnson, Nov 23, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Blake Griffin on James Johnson, Patty Mills, Jevon Carter
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Blake Griffin on the Nets adding Patty Mills, Jevon Carter, James Johnson and Deandre' Bembry in free agency:

“I thought the front office did a great job of targeting exactly what we needand going out and getting it.”

Blake Griffin on James Johnson, Patty Mills, Jevon Carter, Aug 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on James Johnson, Josh Richardson, Dwight Powell
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Mavs getting tougher 4 this SZN:

“Dwight Powell was 1 of our tougher guys last year. He's back now. That gives us toughness. James Johnson has multiple ratings in the martial arts. He gives us toughness. Josh Richardson is an edgy guy who is a terrific defender.”

Rick Carlisle on James Johnson, Josh Richardson, Dwight Powell, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Pat Riley on James Johnson, Dion Waiters
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Riley on Dion Waiters and James Johnson:

“Both of them, we need more from them. We need them to be in the best shape in training camp and with the best health.”

Pat Riley on James Johnson, Dion Waiters, Jun 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on James Johnson, Dion Waiters
item.description:
Spoelstra on James Johnson and Dion Waiters:

“They’re able to both do a lot more. So, I’m encouraged by it. There’s not a timetable on either one of them. But as long as they’re making progress, we’re good.”

Erik Spoelstra on James Johnson, Dion Waiters, Oct 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on James Johnson
item.description:
Heat center Hassan Whiteside said.

“Why does nobody know that? He’s the best iso defender, go look it up. You all like numbers so he should be a first-team All-Defensive guy to me. Nobody talks about it. We have a ton of guys that’s just amazing defenders. I just used him because he’s No. 1 in the NBA. A lot of people would be like Kawhi Leonard or Draymond (Green). No, James Johnson is No. 1.”

Hassan Whiteside on James Johnson, Mar 17, 2017. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Dwane Casey on James Johnson
item.description:
Dwane Casey on James Johnson:

“Unbelievable. I look at him and he looks like a different person, his body, his form. That’s a credit to him and whoever he’s working with has done a great job in transforming his body. He’s lighter, he’s not carrying around extra weight and he’s moving like a guard. He handles the ball in transition. He’s really disciplined himself in making good decisions. That’s what James’ challenge has always been but he’s doing a great job. I’m happy for him except when he plays against us.”

Dwane Casey on James Johnson, Mar 11, 2017. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on James Johnson
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:More DeRozan on James Johnson:

“Everything about JJ is great. He jokes all day. It's just people think because he's a black belt he crazy”

DeMar DeRozan on James Johnson, Nov 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jose Manuel Calderon, Amir Johnson, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson, Andrea Bargnani
item.description:
Dwane Casey on the core players in Toronto:

“Andrea (Bargnani) is definitely a piece of the core that we have to utilize. He’s our star. DeMar Derozan is definitely an athletic part of our core, Jose Calderon, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson is in that group, and Amir Johnson. You’ve got the core now. The part you may have to add is a veteran piece, a veteran defender or whatever along with our draft pick is something that I’m sure Bryan and the staff are going to look at, but the core pieces are there to build on to use as building blocks. Those guys are the guys were gonna push, cajole, put an arm around, or whatever it takes to get to that next level.”

Dwane Casey on Jose Manuel Calderon, Amir Johnson, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson, Andrea Bargnani, Jun 22, 2011. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.
